summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology focused on embedded robotics and real-time computer vision systems. Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson with FreeRTOS-coordinated STM32 actuation and built a distributed robotic arm achieving 100% pick reliability after resolving 11 hardware-software integration failures across C++, Python, and ROS2.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset; trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation.
Exported model to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment, validating inference outputs across formats.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm with z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo crosstalk, rolling-shutter depth); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Integrated TensorRT YOLOv8 visual servoing at ~18 FPS with dual VL53L0X ToF contact sensing; implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++.
Built a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter client → Flask-SocketIO edge server → Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Ran YOLOv8 object detection on NVIDIA Jetson; sent real-time control commands to STM32 over UART for multi-servo PWM actuation.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing with interrupt-driven UART command parsing.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) for lane detection; achieved zero collisions across multiple laps in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians.
Built automated data pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
